firstScreen.notes: 1440-first.jpg: concept-only composition (drawing + riveted plate across the seam, tool in hero), one loud Call + quiet secondary, phone visible, Sample proof line. h1 has no trade/place (-0.5); hero exactly 900px, no peek (-0.5). 390-first.jpg: hero Call, plate output and proof below fold, header/bar Call saves it (-0.5).

distinctiveness.notes: 1440-full.jpg: plate primitive in hero, story, services, parts, repair/replace, insulation, reviews, area, footer, and it organises info. Differs from A/C 1440-first.jpg. CC-0N serials decorative and mono caps everywhere; spring+tick meter topic shared with A.

type.notes: Libre Franklin 800 tight + Public Sans + Martian Mono coherent; tabular prices (1440-scroll-50.jpg). 1440-first.jpg: tracked mono caps on kicker, step labels, all chips and the proof line (-0.5). 12px mono sub-labels in services/footer (1440-full.jpg).

layout.notes: 1440-full.jpg: tone run paper/deep/paper/zinc/blue/deep/paper/zinc/paper/deep/zinc, no dark touches, dense ledger + quiet salt band. S-01 feature plate ~300px empty (-0.5); heading-left/plate-right 5 times (-0.5); grid-break credit (+0.5). 1440-scroll-75.jpg: empty column under insulation plate.

photo.notes: 1440-full.jpg / 390-full.jpg: zero photos and zero video (dist has 0 img). Line drawings are consistent and part of the signature, but no real door, spring or garage is ever shown; no 'one shoot' grade possible.

copy.notes: Real trade nouns (winding cone, travel limit, two-by-four), Sample labels everywhere, 1 em dash. 390-full.jpg / 1440-full.jpg: 'measured at your door' on 11 plates + hero, even where facts have prices (-0.5); ~6 names for the quote action (-0.5); microcopy at doubt moments (+0.5).

mobile.notes: 390-full.jpg: no overflow, 2-col chips, story unpinned and stacked, bottom bar. 'Price it' links ~20px tall x11 (mustFix, cap); 11 identical full-width plates ~3,300px, collapsed not composed (-0.5).

a11y.notes: 1440-rm-full.jpg: every word of the story and all plates visible in reduced motion. dist: skip link, 3px accent focus-visible with offset and per-tone --focus, 3 aria-live regions, forced-colors rules, one h1. The hero widget readout is marked up as an h2 'Reading'.

motion.notes: 1440-scroll-25.jpg: the story explains (cycles, coil gap, bang line, BROKEN stamp); 7 hooks; no bounce. Plate hover lift on every card + data-reveal on 9 blocks (-0.5); the finder lighting the drawing is unproven in 1440-first.jpg.

wow.notes: 1440-scroll-25.jpg + 1440-rm-full.jpg: the spring counting to 10,000 and snapping is tied to the thesis and ends on price + Call; the hero finder stamps its output on a signature plate (1440-first.jpg). Reads in reduced motion. The finder output is still text rows, and no filled state is shown.

polish.notes: dist: apple-touch, OG 1200x630, JSON-LD, print, forced colors, one radius. 1440-full.jpg footer nameplate: licence breaks 'SAMPLE-OH- / 77120', email splits mid-domain, labels wrap (-0.5).

mustFix.problem: Text links ~20px tall, under the 48px tap target outside a sentence
mustFix.fix: .svc__go{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:48px;padding:0 4px;margin-left:-4px} or make the plate's bottom row the 48px target

elevate.move: Bring one real door into the plate system: a single on-topic library frame becomes the drawing's photographic twin, wiped in along the hero seam as the finder answers, or as a zinc/yellow duotone crop of a real bottom section behind the drawn salt line, so the art direction reads drawing then real part

Make the h1 the nameplate: stamp trade + city into the headline over 'What broke? Two taps.', and re-cut 390 so a compact reading plate sits right under the chips, so the two taps stamp an answer above the fold on a phone
